notes.subject: תהלל יה / הללו יה
notes.rationale: Root הלל with יה twice — the verse is itself the origin of 'Hallelujah'; repetition lost when rendered as ordinary imperatives.

notes.subject: साँस लेवै वाला
notes.rationale: הנשמה is 'every breath/the-breathing-one' — singular collective, rendered with relative clause.

notes.subject: הללו יה
notes.rationale: Final summons closing the Psalter; call to all breathing things.

translation: सब जीव-जंतु जे साँस लेवऽ हइ, ऊ सब याह के परसंसा करो; याह के परसंसा करऽ।
